title: 第3章 大赚一笔第4章 嫂子怀疑
slug: 觉醒阴阳神功分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
陈阳伸手接过袋子，轻轻扫了一眼，里面装着一沓现金，约莫一万块样子。
他挠了挠头，语气有些不自然地解释道：“我的工资卡在我女朋友唐欣悦那里，我不想跟她开口要钱，没事的嫂子，你先回去吧，谢谢你啊。”
宋萌萌眉头微微蹙着，眼神里依旧满是不放心，轻轻摇了摇头：“不客气，都是自己人。”
说完，她依旧站在原地，目光紧紧盯着陈阳，没有挪动脚步。
陈阳见状，只好又开口劝道：“嫂子，你回去吧，好好照顾恒哥，他醒酒了估计也会找你。”
“没事。”宋萌萌摆了摆手，笑意浅淡，“我在这边待一会儿，等你忙完再回去也不迟。”
陈阳看着她的眼神，心里渐渐明白了。
宋萌萌这是担心他被骗，所以一直盯着他。
他心里一暖，却也没再多说，只是悄悄留意着不远处的赌石摊位。
就在这时，一对年轻男女手牵手，说说笑笑地走向他看中的那个赌石摊位。
男人正指着他选定的那块黑色原石，似乎在和女人商量着什么。
陈阳心里一紧，生怕那藏着冰种翡翠的原石被人抢走，当即抬脚就朝摊位走去。
宋萌萌见状，瞬间傻眼了，连忙快步上前，伸手拉住陈阳的胳膊，语气急切又带着几分劝阻：“陈阳，你别上头啊！这里的赌石跟赌博没两样，十赌九输，想要开出宝石根本不可能，别浪费钱！”
陈阳脚步一顿，回头看向她，语气温和却坚定：“嫂子，我心里有数，谢谢你提醒我。”
说着，他就想挣开宋萌萌的手，继续往前走。
宋萌萌却攥得更紧了，语气带着几分强硬：“陈阳，你听劝！你要是非要买，这钱我就不借你了！”
陈阳无奈，只好放缓语气，哄道：“嫂子，我就买这一块，就一块！买完切开看看，要是里面什么都没有，我以后再也不碰赌石了，行不行？”
宋萌萌看着他恳切的眼神，脸上露出犹豫的神色，手指微微松动，最终还是松开了手，气鼓鼓地盯着他，脸颊鼓得圆圆的，像个受了委屈的孩子。
在陈阳看来，她这副模样，倒是格外可爱。
见宋萌萌没有再阻止，陈阳松了口气，连忙快步走到赌石摊位前，对着摊主说：“老板，这块石头，4000块我要了。”

摊主眼睛一亮，连忙笑嘻嘻地接过陈阳递过来的钱，数了数，确认无误后，脸上的笑容更浓了，连忙说：“小兄弟，交易结束，可不许反悔啊！”
陈阳淡淡点头：“绝不反悔。”
一旁的宋萌萌无奈地叹了口气，走上前，语气里满是恨铁不成钢：“陈阳，我真不知道该怎么说你才好，这钱要是打了水漂，看你怎么跟欣悦交代。”
陈阳冲她笑了笑，语气轻松：“嫂子放心，没事的，反正亏了钱也是我自己的，不影响什么。”
这时，摊主拿着那块原石，笑着问：“小兄弟，要不要现在切？我这有切石机，免费帮你切。”
陈阳毫不犹豫地点头：“切，麻烦老板帮我切一下。”
“好嘞！”摊主应了一声，当即领着陈阳走到摊位旁的切石机边上，小心翼翼地将原石卡稳，然后抬头，郑重地看了陈阳一眼，似乎在确认他的心意。
陈阳冲他微微点头，语气坚定：“切吧。”
摊主这才按下开关，切石机发出“嗡嗡”的声响，缓缓运转起来，锋利的刀片一点点切入原石。
content_en:
Chen Yang reached out to take the bag and glanced at it. There was a wad of cash in it, about 10,000 yuan.
He scratched his head and explained in a somewhat unnatural tone: "My salary is stuck with my girlfriend Tang Xinyue. I don't want to ask her for money. It's okay, sister-in-law. You can go back first. Thank you."
Song Mengmeng frowned slightly, her eyes still full of worry, she shook her head gently: "You're welcome, we are all our own people."
After saying that, she still stood where she was, staring at Chen Yang tightly without moving.
Seeing this, Chen Yang had no choice but to persuade again: "Sister-in-law, go back and take good care of Brother Heng. He will probably come to you when he sobers up."
"It's okay." Song Mengmeng waved her hand and smiled lightly, "I'll stay here for a while. It won't be too late to go back after you finish your work."
Chen Yang looked at her eyes and gradually understood.
Song Mengmeng was worried that he would be deceived, so she kept staring at him.
His heart warmed, but he didn't say anything more. He just quietly paid attention to the stone gambling stall not far away.
At this moment, a young man and woman held hands, chatting and laughing as they walked towards the stone gambling stall he had chosen.
The man was pointing at the black rough stone he had selected, and seemed to be discussing something with the woman.
Chen Yang felt nervous, fearing that the rough stone containing the ice jade would be snatched away, so he immediately walked towards the stall.
When Song Mengmeng saw this, she was dumbfounded. She quickly stepped forward and reached out to hold Chen Yang's arm. Her tone was urgent and somewhat dissuasive: "Chen Yang, don't get ahead! The stone gambling here is the same as gambling. Nine out of ten bets will result in losses. It's impossible to find gems. Don't waste your money!"
Chen Yang paused, looked back at her, and said in a gentle but firm tone: "Sister-in-law, I know what's going on. Thank you for reminding me."
As he said that, he wanted to break away from Song Mengmeng's hand and continue walking forward.
Song Mengmeng tightened her grip, and her tone was a bit tough: "Chen Yang, listen to my advice! If you insist on buying it, I won't lend you the money!"
Chen Yang had no choice but to slow down his tone and coax: "Sister-in-law, I will buy this piece, just one piece! Cut it open and take a look. If there is nothing inside, I will never touch gambling stones again, okay?"
Song Mengmeng looked at his sincere eyes, with a hesitant look on her face. She loosened her fingers slightly, and finally let go of her hand. She stared at him angrily, her cheeks rounded, like a wronged child.
In Chen Yang's opinion, she looked particularly cute like this.
Seeing that Song Mengmeng did not stop him, Chen Yang breathed a sigh of relief and quickly walked to the stone gambling stall and said to the stall owner: "Boss, I want this stone for 4,000 yuan."
The stall owner's eyes lit up, he quickly took the money handed over by Chen Yang with a smile, counted it, and after confirming that it was correct, the smile on his face became wider, and he said quickly: "Little brother, the transaction is over, don't regret it!"
Chen Yang nodded lightly: "I will never regret it."
Song Mengmeng on the side sighed helplessly, stepped forward, and said in a tone full of hatred: "Chen Yang, I really don't know what to say to you. If this money is wasted, it depends on how you explain to Xinyue."
Chen Yang smiled at her and said in a relaxed tone: "Sister-in-law, don't worry, it'll be fine. Anyway, the money I lose is my own, so it won't affect anything."
At this time, the stall owner took the rough stone and asked with a smile: "Little brother, do you want to cut it now? I have a stone cutter here and I will cut it for you for free."
Chen Yang nodded without hesitation: "Tch, boss, please help me cut it."
"Okay!" The stall owner responded, and immediately led Chen Yang to the stone cutting machine next to the stall, carefully clamped the rough stone firmly, then raised his head and gave Chen Yang a solemn look, as if to confirm his intentions.
Chen Yang nodded slightly at him and said firmly: "Cut it."
The stall owner then pressed the switch, and the stone cutter made a "buzzing" sound and started running slowly. The sharp blade cut into the rough stone bit by bit.。
